name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A preview on hover in the dashboard's floating panel, opening after half a second and growing from its trigger.
usage: Preview something a link points to without leaving the page: a workspace member, a domain's brand, an API key's last use. Keep it to what helps decide whether to follow the link, and never put the only copy of an action inside it (it is unreachable on touch).
avoid: Actions only reachable in the card

reference.source: context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/menu.tsx (the floating panel and its pop)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
